checks: Combine the staggered inspection and audit with a contract requiring all checks to finish and infer that Thursday collection is not allowed. Independent blind solve and item-level English, Traditional Chinese, answer and each distractor verified after language corrections. Post-submission vocabulary and usage notes were independently checked against the unchanged item and canonical schema.

activeQuestion.prompt: The buyer may inspect the first batch on Thursday, but the packaging audit will not be complete until Friday. The contract states that samples cannot leave the factory before both checks are complete, so they ____ released for collection on Thursday.
activeQuestion.promptZh: 買方週四可以檢驗第一批產品，但包裝稽核要到週五才會完成。合約規定兩項檢查都完成後才能把樣品帶離工廠，因此，這些樣品週四 ____ 放行供人取件。

options.whyZh: 表示沒有必須放行的義務，不表示禁止放行；合約要求週四不能放行。
週四可做第一項檢驗，但第二項要到週五才完成；合約要求兩項都完成，因此週四不能放行供取件。
這是對進度的正面推測，與兩項檢查週四無法都完成的明確時程衝突。
might 表示仍有可能；依已知稽核時程和合約，週四並不符合放行條件。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 週四可做第一項檢驗，但第二項要到週五才完成；合約要求兩項都完成，因此週四不能放行供取件。
activeQuestion.evidence: The buyer may inspect the first batch on Thursday, but the packaging audit will not be complete until Friday. The contract states that samples cannot leave the factory before both checks are complete, so they ____ released for collection on Thursday.

vocabulary.zh: 不能；不准（後接過去分詞時表被動）
vocabulary.note: cannot be 加過去分詞可表示不允許對某物執行該動作；cannot be released 指尚不能放行樣品。

originalQuestion.prompt: Ms. Chen has worked in supplier quality ____ 2019.
originalQuestion.promptZh: 陳女士____ 2019 年便一直從事供應商品質管理工作。

options.whyZh: for 後接一段時間，例如 for seven years，不直接用此處的年份作期間。
until 2019 指結束點，與 has worked 所表達的持續起點不符。
during 2019 只指那一年期間，無法表達持續至今的起點。
2019 是起始時間點，完成式搭配 since 表示持續至今。

originalQuestion.explanationZh: 2019 是起始時間點，完成式搭配 since 表示持續至今。

vocabulary.note: 對供應材料或供應商製程品質的管理。
